A1.justification: Both PDFs describe The Curse of Depth in Large Language Models. All 30 pages, including equations, figures, tables, proofs in Appendix A, and Appendices B–D, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original model training, fine-tuning, vision experiments, and layer-pruning and variance analyses in Sections 2, 5–6 and Appendices B–C.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–8 and the supplementary variance and vision-language pruning experiments.

M1.justification: LayerNorm Scaling retains the same inverse-square-root depth scaling in Equation 12, placement, and model components. The Figure 5 terminology correction does not modify the proposed method.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same language-model training and downstream tasks, ImageNet-1K vision experiments, and Appendix C's MMMU vision-language pruning evaluation. No dataset or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding experiments, including Post-LN, Pre-LN, DeepNorm, Mix-LN, and the normalization, initialization, and scaling alternatives in Tables 6–8.

E3.justification: Model sizes, training budgets, optimization settings, benchmark metrics, pruning procedures, and token averaging are unchanged. Figure 5 is relabeled consistently with the residual-block diagnostic already described in Equation 5.

E4.justification: The same pruning, angular-distance, variance-growth, scaling, and insertion-position analyses remain in the main text and appendices. Figure 5 retains the same heatmaps and diagnostic question; its description is clarified.

E5.justification: Neither version adds or revises repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty reporting. Existing averaging practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted data, and reported trends are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains LNS perplexities of 25.76 for LLaMA-130M and 15.71 for LLaMA-1B. Figure 5's matrix images are identical.

T1.justification: The assumptions, lemmas, theorems, equations, and Appendix A proofs are unchanged. The revised description of Figure 5 does not introduce or correct a formal definition, derivation, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about ineffective deep layers, Pre-LN as their cause, and LNS improving layer utilization, training stability, and performance.

C2.justification: Section 3.1 and Figure 5 replace 'LayerNorm Jacobians' with Jacobians of 'pre-LN residual blocks.' This clarifies which component is interpreted as approaching an identity mapping, aligning the explanation with Equation 5. Other interpretations and Appendix D's limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation and training details, learning rates, configuration disclosures, and the code-repository hyperlink are unchanged. No additional implementation instructions or resource-access information are supplied.

R1.justification: Related work, cited works, and research positioning are unchanged. The added NeurIPS acceptance note supplies publication metadata without revising the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: The revision makes localized terminology edits around Figure 5 and adds 'Accepted at NeurIPS 2025' to the first-page footnote, alongside updated version/date metadata. Section organization and the remaining prose are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 5's caption is revised, with localized text reflow on pages 7–8 and an expanded first-page footnote. Figure panels, table structures, placement, and the remaining page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revised Figure 5 description better distinguishes residual-block Jacobians from normalization-only Jacobians, reducing confusion about the identity-mapping mechanism and improving consistency with Equation 5. The benefit is limited: the caption still uses 'deep LayerNorm blocks,' and the empirical evidence and formal arguments remain unchanged.
